load_mase_metric: load the mase metric using evaluate.load for computing mean absolute scaled error
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the mase metric to interactively evaluate predictions
run_mase_evaluation: run the mase metric to compute mean absolute scaled error on predictions and references
compute_mase_score: compute the mase score by passing predictions and references to the loaded mase metric
evaluate_time_series: evaluate time series forecasts using the mase metric with baseline comparisons
